perseverance.glb.title: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover
perseverance.glb.format: glTF 2.0 / Draco geometry / embedded WebP textures
perseverance.glb.modifications: Original GLB unchanged. EGIZ adds runtime camera, lighting, part classification, highlighting and inspection offsets.
perseverance.glb.scope: Reference visualization. Not the EGIZ dynamics, collision or configurable vehicle model. No NASA endorsement implied.

draco.runtime: Same-origin JavaScript decoder; no CDN or WebAssembly permission required.

saturn-v.glb.title: Saturn V
saturn-v.glb.modifications: Original GLB unchanged. Runtime static inspection partitions triangles into approximate geometric regions, preserving surface geometry, normals, UVs and materials. Source animation tracks are not played.
saturn-v.glb.scope: Visual reference only. Source units are normalized for inspection. No certified dimensions, mass properties or historical vehicle dynamics implied.
